# Hugh Carrow

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P37](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0037), [v1 c15 P67](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0067)</sub>
- **Role:** Doctor and former teacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v2 c7 P13](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0013), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018), [v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012)</sub>
- **Titles:** Medalist  <sub>[v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003)</sub>; Dr. Carrow  <sub>[v4 c7 P7](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0007), [v4 c13 P7](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0007), [v4 c31 P12](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0012)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Hughie  <sub>[v1 c25 P55](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0055)</sub>

## Appearance

Hugh is a high-statured youth with wavy chestnut hair, mischievous light-brown eyes, and a mouth contorted into a mocking grin. As he matures into adulthood, he is described as a tall, open-faced guy possessing broad shoulders and bright, direct eyes.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Hugh possesses a playful, daring nature and a sense of humor, often enjoying mischievous teasing of schoolgirls. He is smart, ambitious, and possesses individual perspectives on life with a resolve to do his best. Despite his mischievous demeanor, he is friendly and willing to apologize when he realizes he has caused offense. He also displays the persistent stubbornness characteristic of the Carrows when sticking to what he considers his duty.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P29](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0029), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v4 c29 P38](../source/v04-c29.md#nw-v04-c29-p0038), [v4 c30 P2](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0002)_

## History

During his school days in Brierley, Hugh was known for his playful pranks and academic rivalry with Nell Harcourt, whom he once teased by calling 'Carrots'. Though he immediately tried to apologize, Nell nursed a long-standing grudge against him. Despite this, Hugh consistently achieved top academic results, winning the school medal upon passing the Entrance examinations. To fund his own college education, he worked as a teacher in Pale Sands before attending university at Wexcombe, where he earned High Honors in Classics and won the Cooper Prize.

Over time, Hugh and Nell reconciled their enmity and established a close friendship, eventually organizing the local Improvement Society together. Hugh eventually proposed to Nell, but she initially rejected his offer of marriage, leading to a period of distance between them. After suffering a severe case of typhoid fever following intense university studies, he recovered and eventually reconnected with Nell. The two were married and relocated to Glen St. Agnes at Seven Gulls, where Hugh assumed the medical practice of his great-uncle, Dr. David Carrow.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c36 P3](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0003), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v2 c1 P55](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0055), [v3 c20 P45](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0045), [v3 c20 P48](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0048), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P25](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0025), [v4 c1 P5](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0005), [v4 c1 P18](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0018)_
